mapper.sql: FROM user_activity a JOIN monitoring_student u ON u.user_id=a.user_id
a.activity_date >= (CAST(#{f.start} AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AND a.activity_date < (CAST(#{f.end} AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date
mapper.select: SELECT a.activity_date AS "day",count(DISTINCT a.user_id) active_users,count(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER(WHERE (u.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date=a.activity_date) new_users WHERE GROUP BY a.activity_date ORDER BY a.activity_date

WITH previous AS(SELECT DISTINCT a.user_id WHERE a.activity_date >= (CAST(#{previousStart} AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AND a.activity_date < (CAST(#{f.start} AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date ),current AS(SELECT DISTINCT a.user_id WHERE ) SELECT count(*) FROM previous p JOIN current c ON c.user_id=p.user_id
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.user_id) FROM monitoring_online_at(#{now}) s JOIN monitoring_student u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE true AND s.client_type=#{f.platform}
mapper.sql: WITH visits AS(SELECT a.user_id,count(DISTINCT a.activity_date) active_days,max(a.last_seen_at) last_active_at WHERE GROUP BY a.user_id), learning AS(SELECT s.user_id,sum(s.answered_count) answered_count,sum(s.correct_count) correct_count,sum(s.duration_seconds) duration_seconds,max(s.submitted_at) last_active_at FROM monitoring_learning s JOIN monitoring_student u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE GROUP BY s.user_id), ranking AS(SELECT coalesce(v.user_id,l.user_id) user_id,coalesce(v.active_days,0) active_days,coalesce(l.answered_count,0) answered_count, coalesce(l.correct_count,0) correct_count,coalesce(l.duration_seconds,0) duration_seconds,greatest(v.last_active_at,l.last_active_at) last_active_at FROM visits v FULL JOIN learning l ON l.user_id=v.user_id)
